jobs.descriptionHtml:
Teach For India Fellowship 2027 applications are open! Get ₹30,000/month stipend, housing allowance & health insurance. Check eligibility and apply now.

About Teach For India

Teach For India is a nationwide movement dedicated to eliminating educational inequity in India. Through its flagship two-year program, Fellows work full-time in English-medium government or low-fee private schools serving underserved communities.

The program is widely recognized as a premier leadership development pathway. Currently, approximately 1,000 Fellows teach across India, supported by an alumni network of over 5,500 professionals and the global Teach For All network spanning more than 62 countries. Alumni include graduates from institutions like Delhi University (LSR, Hindu College, Daulat Ram), St. Xavier’s, Christ College, TISS, Jadavpur University, Anna University, and Symbiosis, alongside former corporate professionals from organizations such as Deloitte, EY, TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Salesforce, Citibank, and Axis Bank.

Role & Classroom Placement Details

Fellows are placed as full-time teachers in English-medium government or low-fee private schools across nine Indian cities: Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Pune.

Grades Taught: Classrooms between Grade 1 and Grade 10.

Subjects Covered: Depending on school placement, you will work as a class teacher or subject teacher covering English, Mathematics, Social Studies, and Science (excluding regional languages).

Language Requirement: Instruction is in English. Knowing the local mother tongue helps when engaging with communities, though it is not a mandatory prerequisite.

Training & Readiness: No prior teaching background is required. Fellows undergo structured training through the Leadership Development Journey (LDJ) and a Summer Institute before entering classrooms.

TFI Fellowship 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Before starting your Teach For India fellowship 2027 apply online form, verify that you meet all official conditions:

Educational Qualification: You must have completed your graduation (Bachelor’s degree in any discipline) by June/July 2027. Final-year college students graduating by July 2027 are eligible to apply.

Nationality: You must be a citizen of India or an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI).

Application Limit: You must be applying for the first time for the 2027 Fellowship cohort since July 2026. An applicant can apply only once during each selection cycle (between July 2026 and March 2027).

Age Diversity: While there is no restrictive upper age cap mentioned, cohorts historically include Fellows aged 22 to 64, welcoming both freshers and experienced career pivoters.

Full-Time Commitment: Fellows cannot pursue any other external academic degree or professional job during the two-year fellowship period. Deferrals are also not permitted.

Stipend, Housing Allowance & Fellowship Benefits

Teach For India provides a structured financial and support package so Fellows can focus entirely on their students and leadership growth:

Monthly Stipend:₹30,000 per month, including during the initial Summer Institute training period.

City Compensatory Allowance (CCA): Relocating Fellows receive a housing allowance ranging from ₹6,000 to ₹12,600 per month, depending on the placement city (payable once you move to your assigned city).

Health & Wellness: Comprehensive health insurance coverage of up to ₹1,00,000 along with access to free counselling services.

Classroom Reimbursements: Reimbursements for work-related expenses, such as classroom and school supplies calculated on a per-child cost basis.

Leaves & Holidays: Casual and sick leave, plus national, regional, school holidays, and a summer break.

Post-Fellowship Career Support: Second-year Fellows access resume workshops, mock interviews, and two dedicated Career Fairs (an Internal Career Fair for staff roles and an External Career Fair featuring 100+ employers across corporate, governance, and social development sectors).
